project.title: CivicLens AI
project.short_description: Agentic urban-infrastructure intelligence with a React dashboard: complaint ingestion, duplicate detection, geo-temporal hotspot analysis, evidence-backed recommendations and authenticated human review, all persisted and computed in IBM Db2. Every recommendation shows who or what wrote it (real LLM, labelled rule-based fallback, or analyst).

ibm_db2.edition: Db2 Community Edition 12.1 (Docker); Db2 on Cloud planned for hosted demo
features_used: Relational tables with CHECK / FOREIGN KEY constraints
Identity columns with SELECT ... FROM FINAL TABLE (INSERT ...)
Secondary indexes for geo-cell and time-window queries
In-database haversine distance (SQL trig functions) for duplicate detection
GROUP BY / HAVING aggregation for hotspot analysis
Composite foreign key enforcing evidence integrity across tables
Unique index as a double-review backstop
Compare-and-set UPDATE for atomic state transitions
Multi-statement atomic review transaction with rollback
Dashboard aggregates computed in Db2 per request (GROUP BY, windowed counts, hotspot totals, agent activity from the audit log)
Review queue and recommendation provenance read from Db2 (generator type and model name stored with every recommendation)

ai_models: Provider-agnostic via LangChain: OpenAI, Anthropic or IBM watsonx.ai. NOT yet run against a real provider (no credentials were available; real-LLM verification is BLOCKED, see docs/PHASE_01B_REPORT.md)
Labelled deterministic rule-based fallback (no LLM): used for every recommendation produced so far and shown as 'Rule-based · no LLM' in the UI
